safeguard: Idempotency keys belong to one customer
default_label: Keys are saved without the customer

variants.label: The lookup searches every customer's transfers
variants.root_cause: find_transfer() scans every transfer for a matching key without checking the requester, so a key another customer used returns their transfer and the new one never runs.

edits.replace: return next((t for t in self.transfers if t.idempotency_key == idempotency_key), None)
